newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ITALIAN LOMBARDO TO JOIN CRYSTAL PALACE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ITALIAN LOMBARDO TO JOIN CRYSTAL PALACE.

text.p: Juventus winger Attilio Lombardo has agreed to join newly promoted English premier league side Crystal Palace, Italian news agency ANSA reported on Saturday.

It said Lombardo, an occasional Italy international, had accepted a deal worked out by Juventus and the London club despite having a year to go on his contract with the Italian champions. No details of the deal were given.
Palace's official clubcall service promised news of an Italian signing later in the day but did not name Lombardo.
Lombardo, 31, battled back from injury last season to put in some good performances for Juve but new arrivals meant he faced increased competition to get a game for the Turin club.
